name: Mike Alvey
why: Taken two years before he served and small, one cell of a nine-across grid at the full resolution of the scan, not enlarged. A better frame of the same man exists and was deliberately not used: the 1980 volume prints him at its p. 338 in the senior grid, five to a row and in a suit, but the printed caption there reads MICHAEL W. AEY, a typesetting slip. The 1980 index files that page under Alvey, Michael Wayne, the hometown and middle initial match, and the face is plainly the same one a year older. The rule is that the caption identifies, so the frame that carries his name is the one published; a later pass that accepts the slip should prefer the 1980 portrait.

name: Anne Mckee
why: No class portrait of her exists in any volume of her time at Western, so this is a crop from a group. It was preferred to the other candidate, the twenty-eight-figure ASG group photograph on p. 282 of the same volume, where her face is a third the size and she is caught mid-laugh with her eyes shut and a hand across her cheek. Here she is seated, still and smiling, and the row is six wide rather than twenty-eight. Soft, and it has not been enlarged. The Talisman prints her surname McKee; the archive's own spelling is left as it stands.

name: David Sturgeon

src.label: 1981 Talisman, p. 282, the Associated Student Government group photograph. The caption names six in the front row, seven in the second, eight in the third and seven in the back, and the photograph holds exactly that: 6, 7, 8, 7 heads in four bands. Hines is the second of the eight third-row names and the crop is the second figure from the left in that band. The reading of the rows is checked against three men in the same photograph whose class portraits the archive now holds: Lonnie Sears, first in the second row and the only figure there wearing aviator glasses; James Buckner, first in the third row and moustached; and the third row's only woman, Margaret Ragan, standing seventh where the caption's only woman's name is seventh. The Interhall Council photograph beside it also names Perry Hines, last in its back row, and that figure is the same man.
